account_id.description: account_id for which the card will be associated to

credit_limit.description: credit_limit for the card. Provide only when creating commercial secured cards.

card_design_id.description:
The visual design of card.
Please contact Support to start creating card designs.

street.description: Has a 1 to 40-character limit. May only contain alphanumerics and the special characters `. , _ - #`

street2.description: Has a 40-character limit, inclusive. Must start with an alphanumeric, and may only contain alphanumerics and the special characters `. , _ - #`

city.description: Has a 2 to 40-character limit. May contain only alphanumerics, `-`, `_`,`.`, and spaces

state.description:
Has a 2-character limit for US address.
Has a 20-character limit for non US address.

zip_code.description:
zip code in 5-digit (12345) or 9-digit (12345-1234) format for US address.
Has a 2 to 20-character limit for non US address.

country.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
Has a 2-character limit.
